FULL TEXT:
ADVERTISEMENT NOTICE FOR 232 POSTS OF JUNIOR CLERK IN THE BANK
The HP State Cooperative Bank Ltd., which is a leading Cooperative Bank in the country and
the Apex Cooperative Bank in Himachal Pradesh, invites ONLINE applications from eligible
candidates for the recruitment to 232 posts of JUNIOR CLERKS {158 posts under direct
recruitment quota + 74 posts under Society (PACS/OCS) quota} in the Bank on REGULAR
BASIS through IBPS, Mumbai as per following schedule:-
Activity Timeline
Opening date for submission of online application
through live link to be provided for said purpose
on Bank’s website.
06.03.2024
Last date for submission of online application. 31.03.2024 (till 11:59 P.M.)
The desirous candidates should read Detailed Instructions for Recruitment of Junior
Clerks on Bank’s website www.hpscb.com. Application for the said posts can be filled
ONLINE through Recruitment Link on Bank’s website between 06.03.2024 to 31.03.2024
till 11:59 P.M. along with payment of requisite fee. Thereafter the Recruitment Link will be
disabled. Candidates are advised to visit the Bank’s website from time to time for updates in
their own interest.
Applications received by any other mode or after the due date shall not be
accepted.
Managing Director
